# s4communication_outbound_user (Resource)

Outbound User of a Communication System

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Credentials used when SAP calls the remote system
resource "s4communication_outbound_user" "example" {
  communication_system_uuid = s4communication_communication_system.example.id
  name                      = "remote-user"
  password                  = var.outbound_password
}

variable "outbound_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `communication_system_uuid` (String) UUID of the Communication System this outbound user belongs to. Changing this forces a new outbound user to be created.
- `name` (String) User name used to log on to the remote system (max 254 characters)

### Optional

- `authentication_method` (String) Authentication Method, defaults to `basic` (max 20 characters)
- `certificate_id` (String) Certificate ID (max 6 characters)
- `oauth2_client_authentication_method` (String) OAuth 2.0 Client Authentication Method (max 5 characters)
- `oauth2_client_id` (String) OAuth 2.0 Client ID (max 254 characters)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the outbound user (max 109 characters). SAP never returns the password, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is not imported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Outbound User UUID (internal identifier)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.12 and later: import with the resource identity, as listed by
# terraform query
import {
  to = s4communication_outbound_user.example
  identity = {
    id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Outbound user UUID

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Outbound users are imported by their UUID. The password is not returned by
# SAP and has to be set in the configuration again.
terraform import s4communication_outbound_user.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
